text.text_excerpt: I know, I know IT'S A CHAIN! But apparently, from what I've gathered, The Melting Pot has recently had a total overhaul of its menus. My experience here was pretty wonderful. My sweet fiance and I went here on a Sunday night because, after all, dipping bits of food in molten cheese or chocolate is apparently really romantic. I'm not sure why fondue has this reputation. ANYWAY, we got there around 6:30-7ish and the restaurant was pretty deserted. We were greeted by the hostess and told we could sit pretty much anywhere, and we got a sweet window spot to look out over St. Charles. Our server was SO cute and sweet, and was very patient as we badgered her with questions. The menu's layout and...

This place is great. Very fancy, today I came here for my birthday. We got the $20 per person meal. It came with a cheese fondue, salad, and then a dessert fondue. We got the loaded baked potato and spinach dip fondue. The loaded baked potato one was the best!! I will definitely come back here and get that fondue again. For dessert we got then chocolate s'mores & and yin and yang. I also got the Caesar salad. Everything was great and the servers were sweet. Great for a group of people or a date night, the only thing holding the 5th star back is that it's just a little pricy.

Went here for a birthday dinner. It was easy to make a reservation and they even brought out candles on the dessert without us asking. Wait staff was great and able to answer all of our questions. We did the Crave Combo special - cheese fondue, salad, chocolate fondue for $15. Service was good and food was great. Smores chocolate fondue - you'll want to lick the bowl. Not somewhere I need to go every week, but it was a fun and different dining experience. Give it a try!
